description: Choose how an address's holder-pool pair rewards (gold, XAUm, first) arrive. inUsdc=true: each daily payout sells them for USDC in one trade, at no less than the pair's 30-minute average price minus 1% (a worse price pays the pair that day). false: they arrive as the pair token. The choice is one UNSIGNED approval of the pair token to the USDC converter, unlimited (the converter only ever pulls what a payout claim in the same transaction just paid), or its revocation; send it from that address. No step when the address already has that choice.

address.description: The holder wallet; it sends the step

inUsdc.description: true: pair rewards arrive as USDC; false: they arrive as the pair token

pair.description: Pair token symbol or address; default the first pair, gold (XAUm)

name: prepare_pair_rewards_in_usdc
